en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course is in relation to knowledge of Dendrology, respectively Florists (perennials) to disseminate information on the basics of nursery production of ornamental plants, which is generative and vegetative propagation methods, seed production technology in greenhouses and in open land in the nursery compared with developed countries.
